usedFor: CompanyCam holds job-site photos and Slack is where the crew hears about them through “Photo Tagged” and “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Photo Tagged” in CompanyCam, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A tagged photo tells the channel which job needs eyes, without anyone posting it by hand.

watchOut: “Send Message” in Slack waits for your approval today, so a tagged photo will not post on its own.
